The '''Kingdom of Rosenburg''' was a Northern Alliance-associated monarchy named in the [[Bakorian War]] source as one of the states that supported the [[Bakorian Republic]].

== Bakorian War Role ==

Rosenburg's known role in the 1994-back draft set is limited to covert support for Bakoria alongside [[Imperial Rhovland]], [[Theorin Commonwealth]], and [[Federation of Vinterholm]]. That support included the wider Northern Alliance pattern of training, supplies, advisors, intelligence, and diplomatic backing.

== Source Limits ==

No full extracted national article for Rosenburg was found in the current Miraheze page set. This bridge page exists to keep the Bakorian War draft navigable without inventing a full state history.
